name: GunneryPreferenceRow_Flak
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. The FLAK (category 5) authored preference row of the twelve-row block at 00E092C8, 61h dwords on a 184h stride, file-initialized in .data. All 61h entries read: exactly nine non-zero, at indices 0-8, 17h 11h 12h 15h 16h 14h 10h 13h 0Eh = MPlaneKamikaze, MPlaneTorpedoBomber, MPlaneDiveBomber, MSmallReconPlane, MLargeReconPlane, MReconPlane, MPlaneBomber, MPlaneFighter, MTorpedoBoat. Eight aircraft classes and exactly one surface class; MSubmarine (08h) is absent, so gunnery_rank(5, 08h) is 0 and no flak gun can ever be offered a submarine. 00727BD0 inverts it into DAT_00E19BF8[classId + 5*61h]. Reading the whole row matters: 00727BD0's inner loop SKIPS a zero entry (JZ 00727BF7 -> 00727C05) and always runs 61h times, so a late non-zero would count. docs/DEPTHCHARGE_FLAK_ADMISSION.md

name: GunneryPreferenceRow_DepthCharge
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. The DEPTHCHARGE (category 8) authored preference row at 00E092C8 + 8*184h. All 61h entries read: exactly two non-zero, at indices 0-1, 08h 41h = MSubmarine then NavPoint. Category 9 DEPTHCHARGELAUNCHER at 00E0A06C is identical. EXPLICIT REFUTATION of docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md's twelve-category table, which explains categories 1, 5, 8 and 11 together as 'no plane and no submarine exists on this mission, so 00862820 step 3 refuses every candidate on a zero rank': on IJN01 two Ko-hyoteki midget submarines DO exist and ARE engaged, by categories 4 and 6, and this row ranks MSubmarine FIRST. Category 8's zero on IJN01 is the engagement range - 970 m from Cassin to No18 against the 240.0f constant at 00CFA428 that 006E9923 writes for every Type=Depthcharge bullet - and, in the native build independently, 00862820's category-8 arm at 0086289B, which refuses a submarine that 00852820 reports shallow. docs/DEPTHCHARGE_FLAK_ADMISSION.md

name: GunneryPreferenceRow_Catapult
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. The CATAPULT (category 0Bh) authored preference row, the last of the twelve at 00E092C8 + 0Bh*184h. All 61h dwords read and every one is zero, so 00727BD0 writes no rank and gunnery_rank(0Bh, classId) is 0 for every class id in 0..60h; 00862820 refuses at 0086285F and 00863990 refuses at step 3, on every candidate on every tick. The row is genuinely empty and not a casualty of 00727BD0's unbounded write: only category 0 holds an id above 46h (61h), and it lands on rank row 1 index 0 which row 1's own REP STOSD erases. Corroborated by the data: of 422 device records with a Function in classtables/arcade/deviceclasses.lua, all 20 with Function=CATAPULT have no Bullet key of any kind, against 402 of 402 for every other Function; a catapult authors Type=Catapult, PlaneStartPosY, PlaneStartPosZ and ReloadTime instead. It is an aircraft launch device, not a weapon; the category index carries it only because the index IS the device's Function. docs/DEPTHCHARGE_FLAK_ADMISSION.md

name: GunneryDepthChargeCategoryList
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. The fourth of four category lists that follow the twelve preference rows at 00E0A4F8: 08 09 with the terminator 0Ch at 00E0A530. 00861DC0 walks it and writes the whole mask word 3 or 0 over gunneryAi+80h+cat*4 for categories 8 and 9, mirroring the flag to gunneryAi+78h. Siblings: 00E0A4F8 = {1,2,3,4,6} for 00861CD0 (the non-plane bit), 00E0A510 = {1,5,6} for 00861D20 (the plane bit), 00E0A520 = {7} for 00861D70. Categories 0, 0Ah and 0Bh appear in NO list, so nothing ever changes their mask from the constructor's 3. docs/DEPTHCHARGE_FLAK_ADMISSION.md

name: g_aiCommandTypeNames
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_ai_planners, read-only analysis. Fifteen char* indexed by the command class id 0..14, 00E0E308-00E0E343: NONCONTROL, IDLE, MOVE, MOVETO, CAUTIOUSMOVE, REGROUPINGMOVE, ATTACK, MOVETOATTACK, CAUTIOUSATTACK, CLOSEATTACK, DEFEND, DEFENDPOSITION, PATROLTO, RETREAT, SELLING. Read by 00A0FF60, 00A13960, 00A13A60, 00A137D0 and 00A133AB; 00E0E344, the ambient party index, follows it.
